body.en:
## 01 — Your brief
Tell us your product, target market, desired finish and launch plan.

## 02 — Formula & shade
Discuss texture, color and formulation requirements.

## 03 — Packaging
Align the format, decoration and brand presentation.

## 04 — Sample & refine
Review samples and agree specifications before production.

## 05 — Manufacture
Confirm order details, production location, checks and delivery arrangements.
body.zh:
## 01 — 需求沟通
明确产品、目标市场、妆效与上市计划。

## 02 — 配方与色号
沟通质地、颜色及配方要求。

## 03 — 包装设计
确认包材形式、装饰与品牌呈现。

## 04 — 打样确认
批量生产前确认样品与规格。

## 05 — 生产协同
确认订单、生产地点、检查项目与交付安排。

body.en:
金华纤烁化妆品有限公司 is a cosmetics manufacturer based in Jinhua, China. Our manufacturing presence also includes Yuvacosmetics in Indonesia.

We focus on color cosmetics and conversations that turn a brand idea into a considered product brief.

## People. Color. Possibilities.
From lips and eyes to complexion, tell us what you want to create.
body.zh:
金华纤烁化妆品有限公司是一家位于中国金华的化妆品工厂，同时在印尼设有名为 Yuvacosmetics 的生产工厂。

我们以彩妆为主，围绕品牌需求沟通产品、色号与包装。

## 人、色彩与可能
从唇妆、眼妆到底妆，欢迎与我们沟通您的产品构想。
